name: Grandparent's Bible
title: Father’s Heart Bible — Grandparent's Bible
sub: For Grandmothers, Grandfathers, New Grandparents, Great-Grandparents, and Grandparents Raising Grandchildren

hook.h2: You have held two generations in your arms. Your Father has held you through every one of your years
hook.text: Even to your old age I am he, and to your gray hairs I will carry you. I made you, and I will bear you; I will carry you and I will rescue you.
father: Even to your old age I am he, and to your gray hairs I will carry you. I made you, and I will bear you; I will carry you and I will rescue you.
hook.note: Simeon had waited his whole life, and he was old when Mary and Joseph carried the baby into the temple. He took the child in his arms and blessed our Father. Anna, eighty-four, came up at that same hour and spoke of Him to everyone who was waiting. Your years are not behind you. The ones who come after you will know the Father because you held Him out to them.

short350: Grandmas and grandpas, nanas and papas, new grandparents and great-grandparents, grandparents raising grandchildren and everyone who loves a child as their own: the Grandparent's Bible from Father's Heart Bible™ (FHB) is the Holy Bible made for you.

Father's Heart Bible™ in Divine Voice Color™ is a complete Bible, Old and New Testaments, in a fresh translation from the original Hebrew, Aramaic and Greek that reveals God as your Father. It is the first Bible in print where you can see who is speaking: our Father's words in BLUE, the Son's words in RED, the Spirit's words in PURPLE.
It equips you to receive the Father, hear His voice, and know His heart is for you.

For grandmothers and grandfathers, grandmas and grandpas, nanas, papas, mimis and meemaws, new grandparents and grandparents-to-be, great-grandparents, grandparents raising grandchildren, step-grandparents and bonus grandparents, long-distance grandparents, godparents and empty nesters. For the moments that make a family: the first meeting, birthdays, holidays, sleepovers, graduations, weddings and bedtime prayers.

For a hundred and twenty-five years, red letters have shown the Son speaking. Our Father speaks more than three times as often, and until now every word He spoke was printed in black. Now you can see Him speak on every page.

A grandparent has spent a lifetime carrying others — children, then grandchildren, and the faith handed down between them. Our Father made a promise for exactly these years: "Even to your old age I am he, and to your gray hairs I will carry you. I made you, and I will bear you; I will carry you and I will rescue you." He does not set His children down when the hair turns gray. This is a devotional Bible for daily Bible reading and intimacy with God, and one to open with a grandchild beside you, showing the next generation where the Father speaks.
An interpretive translation with a stated theological emphasis: the revelation of God as Father. Not a paraphrase — every word is rendered from the original Hebrew, Aramaic and Greek.
Receive the Father. Hear His voice. His heart is for you.

long.h: He Has Been Speaking The Whole Time
body: For a hundred and twenty-five years, the red letter Bible has shown you the Son speaking. Our Father speaks more than three times as often, and until now every word He spoke was printed in black. Now you can see Him speak on every page. The color marks ownership, not quotation: His words stay His on any lips that carry them faithfully, and words He never spoke are never colored.

long.h: You Carried Them. Your Father Still Carries You.
body: A grandparent has spent a lifetime carrying others — children, then grandchildren, and the faith handed down between them. Our Father made a promise for exactly these years: "Even to your old age I am he, and to your gray hairs I will carry you. I made you, and I will bear you; I will carry you and I will rescue you."

He does not set His children down when the hair turns gray. This is a devotional Bible for daily Bible reading and intimacy with God, and one to open with a grandchild beside you, showing the next generation where the Father speaks.

God is our Father. Not a role He plays. Father is who He is, and Father is His name, the name Jesus came to reveal. This translation lets the Hebrew and Greek speak the distinction they always made: Abba Father, your Heavenly Father, and you, His beloved son or daughter. If the word father is not a word of comfort for you, this Bible is especially for you. The Father revealed here is no projection of broken human fatherhood. He is the original, from whom every family in heaven and on earth takes its name.

features: A single volume complete Bible — 66 books, 1,189 chapters, 31,085 verses
An introduction to each book, and a Father's note closing every book with a short prayer
1,355 study notes, including 31 on manuscript differences
A presentation page — a gift, and a keepsake worth handing on
Paperback and hardcover, 6 x 9, full color throughout: a gift, a keepsake, an heirloom

faq.q: What makes the Grandparent's Bible different from the other editions?
faq.a: It is the complete Father's Heart Bible™ in Divine Voice Color — every book, every page, nothing abridged — with a cover and opening pages made for a grandparent. Those pages include a dedication, Where to Turn, and a presentation page for their name. Everything from Genesis 1:1 onward is the same Bible every other edition carries.

faq.q: Is the Grandparent's Bible a complete Bible?
faq.a: Yes. All 66 books, 1,189 chapters and 31,085 verses, 890 pages, full color throughout. An introduction opens each book, a Father's note and short prayer closes each one, and 1,355 study notes run through the whole Bible.

faq.q: Is it a good gift for grandparents?
faq.a: It is made for it. A 6 x 9 Bible in hardcover or paperback with a presentation page for their name, in a cover made for grandparents rather than a generic pew edition.

For a hundred and twenty-five years red letters have shown the Son speaking. Our Father speaks more than three times as often — 128,579 words across 5,615 verses — and until now those words were printed in the same black ink as the genealogies. In Divine Voice Color you see who is speaking: our Father's words in BLUE, the Son's in RED, the Spirit's in PURPLE. More than one word in four of the Bible is a divine person speaking. The color is a mark of ownership, not of quotation — His words stay His on any lips that carry them faithfully, and words He never spoke are never colored.
